extraction.title: Add AuthzClientCryptoProvider for authorization client cryptographic operations
extraction.head: feature-authz-crypto-implementation

greptile.text: Describes the PR as adding ASN.1 encoder/decoder utilities and an ECDSA-focused AuthzClientCryptoProvider (order 100), plus order()-based provider selection. Confidence score of 2/5. Flags the getBouncyCastleProvider() implementation, buffer overflow risk in ASN.1 parsing, and integer overflow in length calculations.
Says the bit shifting used to build the length could overflow for large values, and suggests Math.addExact or similar overflow checking.
Says the new order() method has no default implementation, which would break existing CryptoProvider implementations. Suggests a default order() returning 0.
Says getBouncyCastleProvider() returns the default keystore provider instead of a BouncyCastle provider, which would break cryptographic operations that expect BC.
Notes that two ASN1Encoder.create().write(...) calls create objects that are immediately discarded. Suggests removing them and chaining the writes into the returned encoder.
Says the logged list of ignored providers gets a trailing comma appended to every entry.
